text:
maya (PM): quick design check — trying to finalize micro-interactions for the capacity controls before Friday. can we surface guardrail warnings earlier?

liam (Prod Designer): +1. thinking: inline hint under min/max when you try to set min>max, but also a subtle animated nudge if you hit the limit repeatedly. demo: 
```
// visual idea
Min: [ 4 ]  Max: [ 8 ]
if user sets Min = 9 -> shake + tooltip: "Min cannot exceed Max (8)"
```

srini (Eng): animation ok but keep it cheap — CSS transform, no reflow. prefer tooltip persistent for 2s then fade. also need an API-friendly validation error from backend: `invalid_capacity_range` so clients can map errors.

zoe (A11y): tooltips need role="alert" and accessible text. if we animate/shake, ensure prefers-reduced-motion respects user OS setting and provide an ARIA live region update: "Minimum cannot be greater than maximum". also color contrast for warning icon — aim for AA.

sam (RESEARCH): from usability test: users wanted more context around "burst" — they interpret it as "spare GPUs" but not sure about billing. recommend microcopy: "Burst: temporarily use extra GPUs to handle spikes (billed separately)." place a link to pricing modal.

liam (Prod Designer): good call. proposed copy for the SLO slider hover: "Target p95 latency (ms). Lower = higher cost; higher = cheaper but slower." should we show an estimated cost delta inline when moving the slider? small badge e.g., "~+12% cost".

maya (PM): product ask: any blockers for showing cost delta? needs to be realtime-ish. srini?

srini (Eng): we can show estimated cost based on token/sec curves, but calculate on the client using cached unit prices. backend can expose an endpoint `/pricing/estimate?pool=...&slo=...`. latency for estimate ~30-100ms — fine for slider updates if we debounce 200ms.

zoe (A11y): cost badge needs accessible label: "Estimated cost increase twelve percent". also ensure color isn't sole indicator — add an icon and text.

liam (Prod Designer): GPU pool selector behavior: when a customer has multiple pools, show the pool health tag (green/yellow/red) + region + an a11y-friendly tooltip for maintenance windows. consider compact mode: pool rows collapse to nickname + small meta pill.

srini (Eng): one more edge: when autoscaler hits min due to guardrail (we forced min up to maintain SLO), we should show a dismissible banner: "Min was raised from 2 to 4 to meet p95 SLO of 200ms — see rollout details." include a link to rollout logs. implement idempotent banner key so it doesn't spam.

maya (PM): sounds good. can design + eng align on copy and microcopy before Friday? liam, can you push updated frames to Figma and include a11y notes?

liam (Prod Designer): will do. I'll add reduced-motion states, tooltip strings, and alternate color palettes. uploading to Figma soon. pinged in thread when ready. :eyes:

sam (RESEARCH): i'll schedule 3 quick follow-ups with participants who struggled before. aim to confirm the cost-delta mental model.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to staging at 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z for feature/autoscale-ux.

maya (PM): thanks everyone — next sync Monday if anything blocks.
